title: Foundations laid
summary: Founded by Late Shri Hari Ram Goel, the group's visionary founder, laying the groundwork for what would grow into one of Nepal's most trusted construction names.

title: Growing the portfolio
summary: Continued and expanded by his son, Late Shri Ashok Kumar Goel — introducing Nepal's first branded bitumen and cement products.

title: Nationwide reach
summary: A branch network opens across the country, and an exclusive partnership brings MYK Arment construction chemicals to Nepal.

title: A one-stop construction partner
summary: Led by the third generation of the Goel family, with a portfolio spanning construction materials, financial services, energy and automotive — and recognized as one of Nepal's top taxpayers.
